entry.title: R1_V1.48.20250425
entry.content:
Original Innioasis R1 software **R1_V1.48.20250425**.
- Model: **R1** (Innioasis) - Package: `rom_r1.zip` - Build tag: `R1_V1.48.20250425` - Build date: 2025-04-25
## Install
1. Download `rom_r1.zip` (every numbered volume if the release has more than one, then `cat rom_r1.zip.* > rom_r1.zip`). 2. Unzip it. Keep the scatter file next to the images. 3. Open SP Flash Tool, choose **Download Only**, load the scatter file from the archive and flash. 4. Or use Innioasis Updater CE: <https://innioasis.app/guide.html>
This wipes the player. Back up music and recordings first.
